description: Carrier-bound domain_separations[] rows of proof-context-registry.json whose object_family and domain literals occur nowhere outside that registry. The gate tools/artifact_lint:proof_context_carrier_family_anchors refuses any such row that is not listed here, so this file is the visible ledger of families that were registered before the gate existed and have not yet been adjudicated. It is a ratchet: entries may only be removed, and a listed family that acquires an anchor is itself an error.
adjudication: Closed on 2026-09-18. All six original entries were adjudicated one by one against the carriers that actually compute them. Three were withdrawn from proof-context-registry.json because no consumer recomputes them: applet_delivery_authentication_record duplicated an object already defined in zh/extensions/applet-integration.md under a different domain spelling; peer_event_submit_service_binding had no verifier at all; realm_state_snapshot_auth_state_issuer_local is an issuer-local opaque commitment that zh/authz/capabilities.md forbids verifiers from treating as a recomputable authorization check. The other three acquired prose anchors in zh/identity/contact-and-direct-conversation.md, which now spells out the closed transcript and the prefix-form digest for request_acceptance_receipt_core, request_source_checkpoint and glare_unconsumed_slot. The ledger is kept at zero rather than deleted so the ratchet stays visible: any new carrier-bound row must be defined, not listed here.
